justification: Strong reconstruction and downstream preservation across sections. The CIFAR top-1 values should be read as benchmark-mimic measurements rather than untouched held-out generalization estimates.
Random dictionary runs collapse toward chance, matching the intended sanity check.
PCA trails the learned SAE across the reported sections.
Recovered monotone sparsity-fidelity curves with Q3 as the persistent late-budget bottleneck.
FieldSAE clearly dominates the VectorSAE on the aggressive-sparsity and RF-local branches.

Single-step transitions work, and the hybrid upper bound shows strong causal sufficiency. The CIFAR top-1 values should be read as benchmark-mimic measurements rather than untouched held-out generalization estimates.
The larger predictor makes the Q3 to Q4 edge worse, not better.
Chain-aware training lifts the re-grounded chain well above the Family I baseline.
Full BPTT closes most of the gap to the hybrid chain.
Fair RF budgeting rescues a branch that earlier looked much weaker.
Rollout-aligned retraining recovers a strong raw chain instead of chance collapse.
Patchwise overlap materially improves over the pointwise vector baseline.
Depth-aware schedules complete cleanly and broadly support the small-context story.
Coarse disjoint tilings fail badly; only the smallest disjoint scale remains competitive.
The winner recipe survives the ResNet-20 / CIFAR-10 transfer grid.
Seed variation is small enough that the qualitative story survives.
Sparse is the best transition carrier among the tested alternatives.
The winner recipe transfers to a deeper CNN and preserves the Q3 bottleneck pattern.
The ViT transfer artifact achieves high prediction agreement with low KL at 5 percent retained.
Interventions show strong importance and locality concentration, though they inherit upstream SAE validity risks.
Dead-feature and duplicate-feature rates are low in the audited sections.
